company.name: Keenable
company.shortDescription: Keenable.ai is a independent web search infrastructure provider built specifically for AI labs and autonomous agents.
company.description: Keenable develops web search infrastructure for artificial intelligence labs and AI agents, providing tools that allow systems to retrieve and use information from the internet. Its Search API supports web-page search and content retrieval, giving developers programmable access to web data for AI applications and agent workflows. The company also offers Time Machine, a point-in-time search API that allows users to search historical versions of web pages and retrieve content from specific snapshots. Keenable provides cloud and on-premises deployment options and supports integration through developer APIs and documentation. Its products are designed for applications that require web grounding, information retrieval, and search capabilities within AI systems.
